catalogue.note: An instance of the v1.2 component, drilled: three fields and the pension transfer declaration checkbox. Chrome set the 14, 12 and 10px text and the 16px field text about 1px higher than Figma’s render, so those styles move down 1px: a measured correction, not a Figma value. Underlined links draw a heavier underline than Figma’s (both use the font’s own thickness). The status bar names SF Pro Text and renders in the system face.
